name: Skills Lab lists seeded skills, opens one, and links show on an agent
description: Covers the L02 skills surface end to end on seeded data: /skills lists the seeded skills as SkillCards (including the imported_url one flagged 'needs vetting'), opening pr-quality-rubric reaches the tabbed editor at /skills/:id?tab=config, the Versions tab shows its snapshot history (the seed writes two versions for this skill), and the seeded Test Quality Reviewer agent's Skills tab shows its linked skills. Read-only seeded data — no model call, no API key. Note the `wait --load networkidle` before each tab click: both editors render a Skeleton until their TanStack Query resolves, and `wait --url` matches on navigation, so the tab row does not exist yet. The sidebar renders nav items as links, so the `role button` locators can only match the in-page tab buttons. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md — use the hermetic runner).

steps.label: the untrusted seeded skill is listed too
the imported_url skill is flagged for vetting
editor opens on the Config tab
versions tab is active in the URL
agent detail settles — the editor is a Skeleton until its query resolves
switch to the agent's Skills tab
skills tab is active in the URL
a linked skill is listed on the agent
